title: The non-real eigenvalue conjecture for RSK operators
statement:
Let $(\sigma,\pi)$ be a pair of compositions, let $\ell(\sigma)$ and $\ell(\pi)$ denote their lengths, and let ${\sf RSK}_{\sigma,\pi}$ be the associated RSK operator. **Non-real eigenvalue conjecture.** If

$$
\ell(\sigma),\ell(\pi)\geq 3,
$$

then ${\sf RSK}_{\sigma,\pi}$ has a non-real eigenvalue. The conjecture has been checked for $\sigma,\pi\in {\mathbb N}^3$ of degree $d\leq 8$, but remains open in general.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.23009

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2024).
source_name: Ada Stelzer and Alexander Yong, “RSK as a linear operator”, arXiv:2410.23009 (2024).
